name: Tolcsva (Hungary)
description: Divided by a white wavy band descending from the upper hoist to the lower fly into a yellow upper fly part and a green lower hoist part, charged in the yellow with the municipal arms of Tolcsva: a white and blue shield with a figure of the Virgin and a grapevine.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
